name: Berries
short_description: Ambient AI scribe for therapists, psychiatrists and PMHNPs that drafts notes, treatment plans and ICD-10 suggestions for review.
long_description: Berries listens during a session (in person or virtual) and drafts the note, treatment plan, ICD-10 code suggestions, patient instructions and pre-session summaries. It has templates for psychiatrists and psychiatric nurse practitioners as well as therapists, and keeps a medications list. The free plan covers the first 20 sessions, then 10 sessions a month; Pro is $79/month for unlimited sessions; group practices are priced on request. The vendor states every account is covered by its BAA and that recordings are not stored.
one_liner: An ambient scribe that covers therapy and prescribing visits, with a usable free plan.
best_for: Psychiatrists and PMHNPs who want one scribe for therapy and medication visits
Clinicians who want to try a scribe at length: 20 free sessions, then 10 free a month
Practices that want session audio never stored
Students, trainees and early-career clinicians (discounted pricing)
not_for: Clinicians who need notes pushed into their EHR automatically (no named direct integration)
Price-sensitive solo therapists who only need basic notes: Pro is $79/month
Buyers who require a published SOC 2 report

seo.title: Berries AI: Free Therapy Scribe 2026 | HeyPsych
seo.meta_description: Berries: free AI therapy scribe with 10 sessions/month forever. $79/mo Pro for unlimited. SOC 2 certified. No recording storage. HIPAA + PHIPA compliant.

faqs.q: How much does Berries cost in 2026?
faqs.a: Berries offers a free tier with 20 sessions at signup and 10 sessions/month indefinitely (no credit card required). Pro costs $79/month ($948/year) for unlimited sessions, AI notes, treatment plans, ICD-10 coding, and letters.

faqs.q: Is Berries free tier really unlimited?
faqs.a: The free tier provides 10 sessions per month forever with no time limit. For a therapist with 8-10 clients seen weekly, the free tier covers a meaningful portion of documentation needs. No credit card required to start.

faqs.q: Does Berries store my session recordings?
faqs.a: No. Berries explicitly does not store session recordings after note generation. PHI is excluded from AI model training. This provides strong privacy guarantees beyond basic HIPAA compliance.

faqs.q: Berries vs Mentalyc vs Upheal: which is best?
faqs.a: Choose Berries for the free tier (10 sessions/month) or if privacy (no recording storage) is paramount. Choose Mentalyc for modality-aware notes and Alliance Genie. Choose Upheal for session analytics and pay-per-session pricing. All three are therapy-specific and HIPAA compliant.

Yes. Berries is HIPAA and PHIPA (Canadian) compliant with a signed BAA. The platform is SOC 2 certified. Session recordings are not retained after processing and PHI is excluded from AI training data.
